notes: LUMA is a self-contained browser desktop with a shared persistent virtual filesystem, terminal interpreter, draggable/resizable windows, snap and context menus, launcher, notifications, lock screen, settings, wallpaper themes and ten built-in apps. Storage falls back to session memory if browser persistence is unavailable; audio is synthesized locally. Node syntax checks and terminal smoke tests covered file creation, read/write, pipes, redirection, copy/move, find and tree; Python validated the metadata and HTML parse. Chromium headless startup stalled in this environment, so interactive browser verification was not completed.
